question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Are you excited about the Spartan Games?
What would you like to see more of?

nodes.text: $Scott stops, and looks around, confused.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, aren't the cheerleaders normally out here?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Are you that aware of their habits?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: No, it's just... Something feels off...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It doesn't matter, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Right, well, where to next, Anj?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Uh... Only $Scott calls me that...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And I think we actually have to get to class...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh, right.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Man, I hate how class is always interrupting my school time.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Split the field in `half?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Split the field in [color=#e23b3b][i]half?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah! It could be like one of those wacky TV shows, where the roommates split their apartment by painting a line down the middle!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Don't those episodes usually result in the roommates realizing it was a bad idea?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I didn't think that far in advance...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Besides, how are we supposed to play football on `half a field?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, how are we supposed to play football on [color=#e23b3b][i]half a field?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah! It kind of defeats the whole point!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Can't you guys play that other kind of football? You know, the kind where you just toss the ball between the posts and spell out animal names?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Are you... Referring to `'H-O-R-S-E?'`
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you... Referring to [color=#e23b3b][i]'H-O-R-S-E?'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, no, that's what the Spartan guys play...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Could we `please` not take sports advice from the guy who looks like he's never even stepped into a gym in his life?
nodes.text_bbcode: Could we [color=#e23b3b][i]please[/i][/color] not take sports advice from the guy who looks like he's never even stepped into a gym in his life?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I did once... I was lost, see...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Enough talk! Let's fight this out!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Guys, please! I'm `sure` we can work this out without violence!
nodes.text_bbcode: Guys, please! I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]sure[/i][/color] we can work this out without violence!

nodes.text: Moments later, Justin, $Scott, and Angie rush away from the football field, where an all-out brawl is raging!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I was wrong! They really wanted to resolve it with violence!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah, well, `great` job talking them out of it! Even `I` know you play H-O-R-S-E with a basketball!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, [color=#3b78e2][i]great[/i][/color] job talking them out of it! Even [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] know you play H-O-R-S-E with a basketball!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That just seems counter-intuitive...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Look, maybe all those guys need is a good tussle. I'm sure there's some other problems we can solve...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What, like, with science?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, with logic! There's no way you guys need the field all day, right?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So why don't we just set up a system where the polo team gets it half the time, and the football team gets it the other half?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: That's... Surprisingly reasonable.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wait, wait... How do we decide who gets it when?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm sure we could draw up a schedule...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oooo! Oooo! I'll do that!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'll just cross-reference everyone's academic schedules with the athletic calendar, and then index it by upcoming weather reports...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Or... Spartan gets it on odd-numbered days, Centerscore gets it on even ones.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Works for me.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, me too.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not so fast... Won't their horses ruin our field? You know, with their hooves?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Dude, our field is already kind of ruined... Ever since some mysterious jerks ran it over as some kind of dumb prank...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Heh... About that...
Lee elbows him.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: We'll take the deal.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Us too... I guess...
A few minutes later, Justin, Angie, and $Scott walk away...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Nice job negotiating back there, little buddy. We'll win you this election yet!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I was really hoping to make a schedule...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Heh!
A little while later, $Scott, Justin, and Angie walk across the school...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You know, I `knew` this would happen sooner or later!
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, I [color=#3b78e2][i]knew[/i][/color] this would happen sooner or later!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Luckily I have several plans `precisely` for this scenario...
nodes.text_bbcode: Luckily I have several plans [color=#3b78e2][i]precisely[/i][/color] for this scenario...

nodes.text: $Scott gives Justin a look.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Told you so.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, you're a genius. I was thinking we should start with the place that will be the source of the most conflict...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm just not sure where that...
Angie pulls up a schematic on her phone.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The football field. It's where the biggest egos are. Plus, if there's any place for things to get violent, it's there. Come on.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You gotta love her!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah... `You` do...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] do...

nodes.text: Justin, $Scott, and Angie arrive at the football field a few minutes later...
And find Centerscore football players and Spartan polo players arguing with each other!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What do you think you're doing here? This is our field!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah! Spartans don't belong here!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: It's ours now too.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This is `Centerscore's` field, and it'll always be Centerscore's field. So go away and take your dumb horses with you!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]Centerscore's[/i][/color] field, and it'll always be Centerscore's field. So go away and take your dumb horses with you!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Whoa, hey, what'd the horses ever do to you?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: They were on our field! Now get out of here, or we'll body slam your stupid faces!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I think you're forgetting the fact that `we're the ones on horses!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I think you're forgetting the fact that [color=#e23b3b][i]we're the ones on horses![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Well, we have pads!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: If we end up jousting, I call that one. He's hilariously stupid.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Grr!
Zach steps menacingly toward Lee...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait!
Everyone turns to Justin!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Who's the pipsqueak?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm the school President! And I'm sure there's a solution here...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Is it for them to take their dumb horses off our field?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Actually, I was thinking maybe you guys could...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's true. Half the time, I can't even stand the creep.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: See? Totally not friends.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Justin might have his own reasons for wanting you to play fair... But he's most definitely `not` just trying to help his friends out.
nodes.text_bbcode: Justin might have his own reasons for wanting you to play fair... But he's most definitely [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] just trying to help his friends out.

nodes.text: Preston eyes Justin warily.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Hmm... You're really telling the truth? You've never played `Ogres 'N' Elves` with this crew?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmm... You're really telling the truth? You've never played [color=#e23b3b][i]Ogres 'N' Elves[/i][/color] with this crew?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: He tried once, but got too upset with the way we managed our guild's gold.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Why would you spend money on temporary armor, when you could make highly profitable investments in the armor trade?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Well... If an unbiased outside observer thinks I'm playing unfair... Maybe there's a `grain` of truth to it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... If an unbiased outside observer thinks I'm playing unfair... Maybe there's a [color=#e23b3b][i]grain[/i][/color] of truth to it...

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I suppose I could roll a new character... One who doesn't have access to all the cool expansion stuff `yet...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I suppose I could roll a new character... One who doesn't have access to all the cool expansion stuff [color=#e23b3b][i]yet...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I'd have to be a commoner all over again...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey, think of it this way... Would you rather play a new character... Or have to play the game all by yourself?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I play by myself all the time!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Mostly it's what my giant does in his off-time... You know, filling out his paperwork, tooling around in his garden... He's got `quite` the green thumb!
nodes.text_bbcode: Mostly it's what my giant does in his off-time... You know, filling out his paperwork, tooling around in his garden... He's got [color=#e23b3b][i]quite[/i][/color] the green thumb!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Okay, okay, I get the message! Just slide me a new character sheet, would you?
Andrew hands Preston a sheet of paper. $Scott gestures to Angie...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey Anj, mind if we have a word with you?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sure!
She steps away from the game. As they walk outside, Justin turns to her...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Did you mean what you said? About how you can't stand me?
Angie pats him on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Only half the time.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm... I'm not?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But what about all those friendship bracelets I gave you? Or all the stories we covered together for the news station? Or that life-size statue I made of you out of macaroni?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You made a macaroni sculpture of me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's what I do for all my friends!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: He's actually quite talented.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But now you're telling me... It was for nothing? We're not even really friends?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I... I mean... We might be, I don't know, acquaintances...

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Ha! I knew it! You're just helping out your `cronies!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! I knew it! You're just helping out your [color=#e23b3b][i]cronies![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Believe me, I used to be an Immortal... I know how corruption works!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No! I... I mean these people aren't my cronies! I don't even really like them!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow, tell us how you really feel.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yeah, seriously man, you're kind of a jerk.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Right, well, I think we've done enough damage here! Justin, can I have a quick word with you?
$Scott pulls Justin aside.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dude, what is wrong with you? Is that seriously your attempt at being appealing? By telling people you don't like them?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It sounds so much worse when you put it like that...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Just... Stand here for a sec, okay? I'll go get Angie.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Shouldn't we do something about the game?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Too late for that. I think we're just going to have to hope this is one of those fires that burns itself out...
From across the room, Justin hears...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do you mean, you turn `into` a dragon?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What do you mean, you turn [color=#e23b3b][i]into[/i][/color] a dragon?!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: That's `elder` dragon, n00b... Check the handbook!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#e23b3b][i]elder[/i][/color] dragon, n00b... Check the handbook!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...Or not.
Justin and $Scott find Angie in the library playing Ogres 'N' Elves with the other nerds... Including Spartan's most prominent nerd, Preston!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey, guys.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: One second. We're wrapping up a battle. Angie, I believe you were sharing the spoils of your victory!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: As the one who slayed the evil Orc-King, I, Angie Elfendale, shall determine who receives what treasure from the Orc-King's substantial trove!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: To Erik the one-armed Giant, I offer this Great Hammer, which also doubles as a prosthetic arm!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hot dogs and toasted buns! Now I'm doubly armed!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Just one moment, pleebs! I cast `Selfish Magnetism!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just one moment, pleebs! I cast [color=#e23b3b][i]Selfish Magnetism![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Uh, that's not a spell I'm aware of.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Figures that a commoner like you wouldn't. It's from the latest Ogres 'N' Elves expansion set, Hobgoblins and Cookie-trolls!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Cookie-trolls? They sound scary `and` delicious! Like fruitcake!
nodes.text_bbcode: Cookie-trolls? They sound scary [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] delicious! Like fruitcake!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'm gonna need to see some documentation on this.
Preston reaches into his backpack and hands Andrew an enormous rule booklet.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Page 274, paragraph 4. Read it and weep, `nerd.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Page 274, paragraph 4. Read it and weep, [color=#e23b3b][i]nerd.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You're playing the game with us!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Yeah, but I'm `cool` about it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]cool[/i][/color] about it!

nodes.text: Andrew flips through the book.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Huh. Selfish Magnetism. If he casts it successfully, he gets all the treasure after a battle.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's not fair!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I `knew` we shouldn't have let him play with his level 85 character!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]knew[/i][/color] we shouldn't have let him play with his level 85 character!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'm afraid he can cast the spell...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But don't worry, it's only successful if he rolls a twenty!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Good luck! Only Taylor rolls twenties...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Where is Taylor anyway?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She said she had some gossiping to do or something...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Now come on, Preston! Get your stupid roll over with!
Preston grins and pulls out a large die with a bunch of tiny numbers on it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa! What is `that?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! What is [color=#e23b3b][i]that?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: It's a hundred-sided die. And since I only have to roll a twenty or greater, odds are strongly in my favor that all your loot is mine!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No way that's legal!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Afraid so. It says so right here... Freezerburn Mages of Level 65 or Higher may roll the Holy Dice of Mega-Rolling!
Preston rolls the enormous die, and it settles with a tiny fifty-six facing straight up.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: All the treasure is now Preston's...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But not my hammer, right? Since it's my new arm and all?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Why do you think I cast the spell, troglodyte? The Great Hammer will fetch me a load of platinum in the market.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're going to sell my arm?! To who? Some kind of... Arms dealer?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I just figured out what that means!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, I don't know about you guys, but I don't even want to play Ogres 'N' Elves if it means playing with Preston!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah, I quit!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me three!
$Scott nudges Justin.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I think this counts as a fire, little buddy.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh, right!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ahem... I don't think you guys want to quit... You love Ogres 'N' Elves!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Not with him playing!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Preston, don't you think you could play a little more, you know, fairly?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: And who might `you` be?
nodes.text_bbcode: And who might [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] be?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm Justin... The school President.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Oh, then how predictable! You're siding with all your Centerscore friends!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's not like that at all. They aren't my friends... Just ask...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I bet she's got all kinds of paperwork ready on the available budget...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh, you think that's all? I guarantee you she already has an emergency folder ready for `exactly` this scenario!
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh, you think that's all? I guarantee you she already has an emergency folder ready for [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] this scenario!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: She... She does?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: She likes to think about these things. She's also got folders for 'Catastrophic Earthquake', 'Alien Invasion' and 'Everyone Suddenly Changes Genders'.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That last one gets... Pretty weird...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That is `remarkably` diligent...
nodes.text_bbcode: That is [color=#e23b3b][i]remarkably[/i][/color] diligent...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah... She's the best.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: She `really` is...
nodes.text_bbcode: She [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] is...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh, dude? No offense, but can you not stare off creepily into space when you say things like that?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh! Right! Sorry! I was just excited by... You know... Her organizational skills... And... How they can help us!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You're such a weirdo. Come on. Let's go find Angie.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...What?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I mean... You know... Physically! Like... I mean... Her body, that is!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You're not really making this any less weird, dude.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sorry, sorry! I just get flustered when I talk about girls! It has nothing to do with Angie, I swear!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah... We're gonna have to work on that if we're going to fix these likability issues.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Like, `I` might know you're just a socially awkward oddball, and you don't really have some kind of weirdo crush on my girlfriend...
nodes.text_bbcode: Like, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] might know you're just a socially awkward oddball, and you don't really have some kind of weirdo crush on my girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But the rest of the student body doesn't, you know?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ha ha... Right... That would be... Weirdo...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Now come on! Let's go find her.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Really... Uh... Pretty...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...What?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Get this done. I'm counting on you two.
Principal Shapiro turns and leaves.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Okay, okay, let's just think this through. To accommodate Spartan students, we're going to need to improve our facilities to meet their expectations...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We'll need some fancy chairs... And maybe a new fountain... And some gold-plated lockers...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Finding the budget for that is going to be difficult... Maybe we could get some extra money by defunding W.H.A.L.E...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This is bad, $Scott, really bad...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Relax, man! You're over-reacting! Angie can totally help us out!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: She's great with this kind of thing!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Angie? Um... I don't think that's a good idea...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Look... I know you and Angie aren't on the best of terms after you, you know, blackmailed her into breaking up with me.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But all awkwardness aside, dealing with the chaos between Centerscore and Spartan is sort of right up her alley...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I can already see her with a map and accompanying spreadsheet...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well... I do suppose she `is` really...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... I do suppose she [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] really...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Well... I appreciate your enthusiasm... But I do want to make sure you have what it takes.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I know this kind of conflict resolution isn't necessarily your strong suit...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ooo, subtle ice-burn...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'll admit that this might not be the kind of problem I usually handle...
Justin stands up dramatically!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But I'm confident that I can be the passionate, charismatic and inspiring President this school needs!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This merger may seem like a storm of chaos and confusion... But with my leadership, we will emerge into the beautiful sunny meadow on the other side!
Principal Shapiro cocks her head to the side and looks at $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Trouble in the polls?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Likability issues.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Unsurprising.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Well either way, this is your lucky day, Justin. This school merger is a perfect opportunity to prove yourself to the Student Body!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not to mention score the votes of all the Spartan guys!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: ...They do get to vote, right?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Just checking!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: While I'm sure $Scott would try to smooth over any tensions with a school-wide party...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's like you're reading my mind!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I was hoping `you` would step up to the task, Justin.
nodes.text_bbcode: I was hoping [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] would step up to the task, Justin.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I don't know... I'm not really good at the whole people-issues thing... I'd probably just mess it up...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: $Scott's really the guy you want.
$Scott spins around and punches Justin in the arm!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dude! What is wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This is `exactly` the kind of thing we were hoping for!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]exactly[/i][/color] the kind of thing we were hoping for!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The Centerscore people are going to be all kinds of upset about this... Which makes it the perfect opportunity for you to show your leadership!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Never let a good crisis go to waste!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Were you always this crafty?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie made me read this book by some guy named Machiavelli. Surprisingly relevant.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, okay then... I guess I'll give it a shot.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: While I'd hoped for more enthusiasm, I suppose I should be grateful you're on board.
Just then, the door opens, and Principal Shapiro steps in!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Justin! $Scott! Exactly the two people I wanted to see!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What's the haps, Shaps?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: The `haps,` is that I need your help.
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#3b78e2][i]haps,[/i][/color] is that I need your help.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Another budget crisis? Because I am ready to crunch some numbers!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Unfortunately, my current predicament is a bit more... Sensitive.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Perhaps you've heard about the recent incident at Spartan Academy...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You mean when Colt did a powerslide under a helicopter?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `So` awesome...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]So[/i][/color] awesome...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Yes, that's... One aspect of what happened. The other is that Spartan Academy has officially been shut down.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: `Nice!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Nice![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Not to revel in another's misfortune, but they really did have it coming...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And that's exactly the kind of attitude I was hoping to avoid. You see... I've volunteered Centerscore to take the Spartan students in.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `What?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]What?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'll have no debate on this point. Those boys deserve an education, same as anyone else.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So lame...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: What I need from you is your assistance in easing the transition.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, okay, I suppose we can begin preparing for next year...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Not next year. Now. Today in fact.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Now?! But... But...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You mean all those rich boys are sliming up our halls `as we speak?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean all those rich boys are sliming up our halls [color=#e23b3b][i]as we speak?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: That kind of sentiment is `exactly` the reason I'm here, `gentlemen!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That kind of sentiment is [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] the reason I'm here, [color=#3b78e2][i]gentlemen![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Relations between our schools haven't always been peaceful...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm tasking you two with putting out any fires that might arise today. And I do expect fires.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Sorry, do you mean `real` fires? Or, like, metaphorical fires?
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, do you mean [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] fires? Or, like, metaphorical fires?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Hopefully the former. Possibly the latter.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: All I want is a minimal level of tension, so that our students, whether Centerscore or Spartan, can focus on their education. Do you think you're up for the job?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yes! Now you're cooking! What do you have in mind?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh... Well... How about a jock party? Everyone dresses like the jocks!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah... The nerds are gonna hate that.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh... Well how about a nerd party? Everyone dresses like the nerds!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hate to break it to you, but the jocks are gonna hate `that.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hate to break it to you, but the jocks are gonna hate [color=#e23b3b][i]that.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well... How about a jocks `or` nerds party?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... How about a jocks [color=#e23b3b][i]or[/i][/color] nerds party?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: That's just bullying! Plus, what about the hipsters and the scenesters and the steamsters?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What the heck are steamsters?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's a new thing. They wear Victorian clothes, listen to indie jazz, and are really into monocles. Don't worry about it.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Okay, okay... I've got it...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We can throw a $Scott party! Everyone can come dressed as you!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah... Let's just table the whole party idea, okay?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't know, man. Speeches are boring.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, they don't have to be, right? What if they were inspiring and dramatic?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I could stand before the school and raise my fist into the air and shout `'once more unto the breach!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: I could stand before the school and raise my fist into the air and shout [color=#e23b3b][i]'once more unto the breach!'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Okay, okay, now I'm feeling it! You should say that one!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Heh, well, I can't really say that one... I mean, I didn't write it... It's... It's from Shakespeare...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I mean, I can't just use someone else's words...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Why not? Just the other day, I printed this article off the Internet and handed it in as my English paper!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Okay, wow, can you just do me a favor and `not` tell me things like that? I'd like to have plausible deniability when it comes to academic fraud...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, wow, can you just do me a favor and [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] tell me things like that? I'd like to have plausible deniability when it comes to academic fraud...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whatever floats your boat, dude. The point is, you gotta get out there and give some of those inspiring speeches! That'll get the whole school buzzing about you!

nodes.title: 300's a Crowd
nodes.subtitle: Centerscore High and Spartan Academy... Together?!

nodes.text: One day before class, Justin sits behind a desk in the Student President's office. $Scott stands in front of him, holding a folder full of papers and charts.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Ahem! I would like to officially call to order this meeting of the 'Campaign to Re-Elect Justin for school President!'

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: ...You don't have to be so formal, $Scott. It's just the two of us.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey man, you're the one who told me you wanted to take this whole `Campaign Manager` thing more seriously!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey man, you're the one who told me you wanted to take this whole [color=#e23b3b][i]Campaign Manager[/i][/color] thing more seriously!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's because you conducted our last meeting while wearing a lampshade on your head and floating in a hot tub! Also, you had a goat for some reason!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh... That meeting was great...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I can't say the same for your poll numbers.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, Angie crunched some numbers, and it looks like you're going to face some stiff competition.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But... No one's running against me!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Not yet they're not. But according to Angie's poll, you're currently losing 60-40 to `Generic Candidate!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not yet they're not. But according to Angie's poll, you're currently losing 60-40 to [color=#e23b3b][i]Generic Candidate![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And before you ask, that `doesn't` refer to a masked, mystery candidate. I know, I know, I was confused too.
nodes.text_bbcode: And before you ask, that [color=#e23b3b][i]doesn't[/i][/color] refer to a masked, mystery candidate. I know, I know, I was confused too.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, I... I know what a generic candidate is. I just can't understand why I'd be losing!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Not to sound overly full of myself, but I think I've been doing a pretty good job as President... Why wouldn't people want to re-elect me?
$Scott takes a chart out and examines it.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, according to the poll, a majority of students at the school find you 'boring'... 'Uninspiring'... 'So-so'... and 'A huge, lame nerd with a big dumb face. Man, I hate that guy.'

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But that's ridiculous! I'm competent and reasonable, and I've totally balanced the school's budget two times over!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, and that's, you know, a third of what matters... But the other half is how likable you are!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Who taught you math?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: See? That's what I'm saying right there! The moment you start talking, I zone out... And I'm here to help you!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: As your Campaign Manager, I'm letting you know that you officially have a likability problem. We need to fix it, stat.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The question is... How do we make you more likable?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well... Maybe I could...

nodes.prompt: Centerscore High and Spartan Academy... Together?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ahem! Girls! I assure you I am here `purely` on school business!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ahem! Girls! I assure you I am here [color=#e23b3b][i]purely[/i][/color] on school business!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And what kind of school business do you have in the `girl's bathroom?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Maybe he's fixing the toilet...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You can fix a toilet?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, I'm not here to fix the toilet. I'm here to tell you all to clear out!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh, you don't get to tell us what to do...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Actually, I do. You see, having this many people crowded into the bathroom is a major fire hazard. And as school President, it's my responsibility to prevent things like that.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh, hello? The school just got flooded with hundreds of hot new guys! This is `way` more important than fire safety!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, hello? The school just got flooded with hundreds of hot new guys! This is [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] more important than fire safety!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah! Fire safety!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Okay, let's try a different tactic. You're all in here because you're trying to figure out what to do about the Spartan guys, right?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: I'm just trying to use the bathroom!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Right, well... The `rest` of you are here because of the Spartan guys, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Right, well... The [color=#e23b3b][i]rest[/i][/color] of you are here because of the Spartan guys, right?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh, yeah?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, while you're in here, what do you think is going on out there?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The Spartan guys are settling into their new school... And meeting all the `other` girls!
nodes.text_bbcode: The Spartan guys are settling into their new school... And meeting all the [color=#e23b3b][i]other[/i][/color] girls!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The nerd girls... The hipster girls... That one weird girl with the monocle...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: They're... Poaching all the `guys!`
nodes.text_bbcode: They're... Poaching all the [color=#3b78e2][i]guys![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: By the time you're all ready to go out... Well, I don't think there'll be any single guys left!
There's a moment of silence...
And then the popular girls rush out in a rapid, tittering wave!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ahhhh!
Justin throws up his hands to avoid getting trampled!
A minute later, no one else is in the bathroom except for Megan.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That went pretty well...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Seriously! Now I can finally wash my hands!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Right! You just... Do... That!
Justin steps back out, where $Scott and Angie are waiting.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Nicely done, Justin!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah, dude, even `I` wouldn't have gone into the girls' bathroom!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, dude, even [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] wouldn't have gone into the girls' bathroom!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well... Not without permission anyway.
Angie playfully punches $Scott in the arm.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What's next? Another problem for me to solve?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The best thing about Centerscore is that it's always been one great, big family...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, the Spartans are our new brothers... And whether we like it or not, we're stuck with them!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So we can keep fighting amongst ourselves and bickering over everything and just plain tearing this school apart...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Or we can accept this is the way things are, the way things are going to be... And start getting to know our 300 new brothers!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: `Hot` brothers...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Hot[/i][/color] brothers...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's weird, Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well? What do you all say? Are we going to keep fighting... Or are we ready to start getting along?
For one moment, no one says anything...
Then Howard slides his chair aside!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess... If one of you guys wants to sit with us... That'd be okay...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Heh... Well... When you put it so sweetly...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Some of you guys are pretty good at football, right? It'll be cool to have some new talent on the team...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: And I guess it'll be nice to have some new girls to hit on!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ooo! Ooo! Me! Hit on me!
$Scott and Angie walk over to Justin.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: `That` was amazing!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] was amazing!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Seriously! I'm... I'm actually impressed!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah.
Justin leans in for a hug... When suddenly, there's the sound of someone softly clapping.
Justin spins around to see Chad standing in the cafeteria doorway!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Well done, tiny man. I'm almost impressed.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Unfortunately... That's the last speech you'll ever give.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh... What?!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: I'm not loving any of these losers!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah, well, we're not loving any of you guys back!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I might love `some` of you...
nodes.text_bbcode: I might love [color=#3b78e2][i]some[/i][/color] of you...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not the time, Nicole!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I feel like everyone is reading a little too literally into my usage of the word 'love'...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I didn't mean, like, `love` love...
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't mean, like, [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] love...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I just meant accept... Get along with... You know, be compassionate to...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yawn, is this guy still talking? All I hear is a vague, buzzing sound...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! He's your school President now! Show him some respect!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Maybe he should show `us` some respect and not be boring!
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe he should show [color=#e23b3b][i]us[/i][/color] some respect and not be boring!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: That doesn't even make sense!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: `You` don't make sense!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] don't make sense!

nodes.text: Mark lunges at Zach, shoving him over! Zach tumbles over a chair and tries to scramble to his feet...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No! Please! Don't fight! We need to all start getting along!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, Justin, but I don't think that's an option... Not with these jerks!
Howard shoves past Justin, and hits Mark with a hard right hook! A fight starts to break out, when suddenly...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Everyone stop!
The room goes still. Everyone spins around to stare at the door, where Chad leans against the frame.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: As much fun as it would be to beat the crap out of these losers... I'm afraid I can't let you do that right now.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Um, thanks for stopping the fight and all, but if you don't mind, I was in the middle of a speech...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And I'm sure it was lovely... But unfortunately, that's the last speech you'll ever give.
Justin, Angie, and $Scott walk into the cafeteria...
Where they find a full-blown riot going on!
Tables have been flipped over! Chairs are scattered across the floor! Food is everywhere... And the room is packed with battling Centerscore and Spartan students!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What the...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Get down!
Jacob dives over, tackling Justin to the ground behind a flipped over table! A half-dozen eggs splatter against the wall right where he was standing!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Why? Why would this be happening?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: It was those Spartan jerks! They were ruining everything for everyone!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: We tried to be nice and work things out, but... They wouldn't listen to reason. We `had` to fight back!
nodes.text_bbcode: We tried to be nice and work things out, but... They wouldn't listen to reason. We [color=#e23b3b][i]had[/i][/color] to fight back!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know I might not have done the best job resolving conflicts, but... How could it have gotten this bad?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Well, it started out as an argument! Then it became a food fight! Then it became a real fight! Then it became a food fight again! Then...
Jacob is cut off by a loud scream and the sound of shattering glass! Another volley of eggs splatters against the table!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: This is bad! This is `really` bad!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is bad! This is [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] bad!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We need to stop it!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What are we supposed to do?!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'll tell you what we do. We fight back until those Spartan bullies can't take it anymore!
Justin grabs Jacob's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Please, Jacob, you can't do this! You're trashing the place!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Sorry, Justin, but it's us or them. We're past the point of no return.
Jacob grabs a chair and hurls it over the barricade! It breaks apart with a clatter!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `Why?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Why?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I don't know... Maybe it could hit someone? War's pretty crazy, man.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This isn't war! It's wanton chaos! And it ends `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This isn't war! It's wanton chaos! And it ends [color=#e23b3b][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Justin stands up and spreads his arms wide.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Attention everyone! As school President, I officially declare a...
Justin is cut off by the impact of two dozen pudding cups and one hurled chair!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `Ufffff!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ufffff![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Justin crumples to the ground! $Scott and Angie rush over to help him!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: This is `unbelievable!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#3b78e2][i]unbelievable![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Yeah! I always thought a school-wide riot would be fun and exciting, like a movie! But this is just dark and confusing, like a foreign movie!
Jacob's phone beeps. He checks a text message...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Uh oh.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh oh...? What, uh oh?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Looks like the Spartans are winning the battle... HQ's given up any chance of victory...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So we're surrendering? The war is over?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: No! Never! The nerds are initiating our last-ditch plan... Smokescreen Omega: Ghost Protocol!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I don't know, but it has a pretty cool name...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: See for yourself!
$Scott peeks up over the barricade...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Uh oh.
On the ground, Justin moans weakly...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What... Is it...?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well... Remember how Principal Shapiro said we'd only have to put out `metaphorical` fires?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... Remember how Principal Shapiro said we'd only have to put out [color=#e23b3b][i]metaphorical[/i][/color] fires?

nodes.text: A few hours later, Justin, $Scott and Angie stand in front of the charred, smoking ruins of Centerscore High...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This is `terrible!` I'm the worst school President ever!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]terrible![/i][/color] I'm the worst school President ever!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh, Justin, that's not true...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You think I'm not that bad?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No, I mean, there's no more school... Which means you're not the President of anything anymore.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Let's just say you `were` the worst school President ever.
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's just say you [color=#e23b3b][i]were[/i][/color] the worst school President ever.

nodes.text: Centerscore High burned to the ground? That's a terrible ending!
Try again, and see if you can do a better job!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: Justin, Angie and $Scott walk into the cafeteria...
Where a major conflict appears to be happening at the Center Table!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know who you think you are, but you do `not` get to sit here! This is `our` table!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know who you think you are, but you do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] get to sit here! This is [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] table!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Sorry, buddy, but everyone knows how social hierarchies work. The popular kids get to sit at the Center Table... And we're the popular kids... Ergo... You get the drift.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah, except you're `not` popular! We are! You don't even go to this school!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, except you're [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] popular! We are! You don't even go to this school!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: We do `now!` And this is our table!
nodes.text_bbcode: We do [color=#e23b3b][i]now![/i][/color] And this is our table!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Look, I don't care how much cooler you are than the guys here, you seriously do `not` get to just claim our table!
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, I don't care how much cooler you are than the guys here, you seriously do [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] get to just claim our table!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Actually... I think we do. Now move!
Across the room, Justin claps a hand to his head!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I swear, every time I put out a fire, two more spring up!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, man, that's the kind of talk that got you this low in the polls in the first place!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know, I know... Strong, inspiring leader and all that...
Justin walks across the room and clears his throat...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Oh jeez. This guy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you want, Justin? We're kind of in the middle of something here...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Look, I know you are... But I can't let this fight go on.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, what are you gonna do about it?
Justin sighs deeply and climbs onto a bench.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Listen up everyone!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know this is a pretty big change for all of us... And no one's happy about it.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The Spartans have just lost their school. They're refugees now, struggling to adjust to a totally different environment...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And the rest of us have to deal with `our` school being flooded with tons of strange, new, and, on the whole, overly competitive people!
nodes.text_bbcode: And the rest of us have to deal with [color=#e23b3b][i]our[/i][/color] school being flooded with tons of strange, new, and, on the whole, overly competitive people!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Well, can't argue with that.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But whether we like it or not, this is the way things are now! And we have to accept that fact!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We need to begin...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, it's clear that the problem is that you two are spending too much time together, now that the schools have merged...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So maybe what you need is to spend a little time apart!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So... See other people?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What? No!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Why would you assume that's what he meant?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't know! Why would we spend time apart and `not` see other people? That would just be... Alone time! Ugh!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know! Why would we spend time apart and [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] see other people? That would just be... Alone time! Ugh!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Is that all I am to you? Someone to be with so you don't have to go through 'alone time'?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wow, guys, this is really getting out of hand... I just meant you could, you know, give each other some room...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hmm.. I guess I could buy Kim some rooms... The real estate market is looking pretty good these days...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Now I just feel like you're willfully misinterpreting me...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Look, Justin, the problem isn't that Tom and I spend too much time together... The problem is that he's a conceited, spoiled jerk who treats people like commodities!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I do not!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You convinced Erik to be your indentured servant!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The kid gets to feel useful, and I don't have to do my own laundry! It's a win-win scenario!
Erik pops around the corner.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You got that right, boss-man sir! May I offer you a backrub? My hands have been described as 'unusually feminine'!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Not just now, Erik. Go pick up my suit from the dry-cleaners, would you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Dry` cleaning? What will they think of next?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Dry[/i][/color] cleaning? What will they think of next?!

nodes.text: Erik scampers off.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I rest my case.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wow, yeah, that probably violates some local labor laws...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Look, Justin, I guess you were just trying to be helpful... But seriously, stay out of our affairs!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah! And stay out of the employment records of the Prince Corporation while you're at it!
Tom and Kim walk off, still arguing. $Scott and Angie come up to Justin...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Didn't work out, huh?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No... I think I just made things worse...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Why can't people just be as simple as budgets and spreadsheets?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I know what you mean...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Come on, let's go to the cafeteria and grab some lunch. I'm thinking the three of us could use a break...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Go on.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, it seems like the problem is, since the schools merged, you two have been spending more time together... Which has made you both far more aware of each other's flaws!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah... Like the way Tom thinks his money entitles him to order everyone around!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Or the way Kim is never on time for `anything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Or the way Kim is never on time for [color=#e23b3b][i]anything![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Or the way Tom will only eat at restaurants with at least one endangered species on the menu!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Or the way Kim talks to her dog as if she was a person!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Snickerpoodle has a great vocabulary!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Okay, okay! Let's not just list each other's flaws...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Instead... Maybe the two of you could focus on each other's strengths! You know... What you like about each other?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Go on, Tom, you first! What's something you like about Kim?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well... Um... I guess... I like how Kim runs her business... She gets so cute when she's ruthless...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Great, great! A little weird, but great! And Kim, what's a thing you like about Tom?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: If I'm being honest... I love how good he is at planning dates... He really knows how to show me a good time...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Perfect! Now you, Tom!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hmmm... I love the way whenever I say bye, Kim gives me a little kiss on the nose before I leave...
Kim turns to Tom.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, I love the way you give the world's best foot massages...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah? Well, `I` love the way you cuddle up with me after a long, stressful day, and let me hold you while we watch riveting dramas about British aristocrats...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah? Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] love the way you cuddle up with me after a long, stressful day, and let me hold you while we watch riveting dramas about British aristocrats...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: `I` love how you don't mind that I always fall asleep during those horrible shows about British aristocrats...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] love how you don't mind that I always fall asleep during those horrible shows about British aristocrats...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And I love the way you make me do all these awesome things I've never done before, like playing mini-golf or racing go-karts...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And `I` love the way you...
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] love the way you...

nodes.text: She leans forward and whispers in Tom's ear.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh you do, do you? Aren't you a saucy little minx?
Kim leans forward and puts her hand on Tom's cheek.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You're a spoiled, self-entitled richboy...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But you're `my` spoiled, self-entitled richboy.
nodes.text_bbcode: But you're [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] spoiled, self-entitled richboy.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Now come on. Let's go see if we can't find somewhere private to make out...
Kim and Tom walk off. Angie and $Scott catch up to Justin.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well? How'd it go?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Good, I think! Borderline inappropriate, but good!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Look at you, man, you're practically a love guru! We've got this election in the bag!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Now come on, let's go get some lunch. I'm thinking the three of us could use a break...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hi... Ladies... How's it, uh, how's it going up in here?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Good times in the bathroom, if you know what I mean?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you kidding me?! Get out of here, you little creep!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, no, you misunderstand! I'm `not` a creep! I'm here in the bathroom because of a great responsibility! See, Angie hates drama, and $Scott called me 'little buddy'...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, no, you misunderstand! I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a creep! I'm here in the bathroom because of a great responsibility! See, Angie hates drama, and $Scott called me 'little buddy'...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: His words make my brain hurt!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah, well, if he doesn't get out of here, I'm about to hurt him...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Look, I swear you have the wrong idea! I'm not here for the purposes of... Looking... At... Bathroom... Girls...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh really?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Really! That's not my thing! That's not what I do! I mean, I would never look at any of you like that!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, what, so we're not hot enough to look at? Is that what you're saying?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What? No! Not at all! I didn't mean to insult you! In fact, I, uh, find you very physically attractive!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: So `right now,` here in this girls' bathroom, you're enjoying looking at us?
nodes.text_bbcode: So [color=#3b78e2][i]right now,[/i][/color] here in this girls' bathroom, you're enjoying looking at us?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well... Technically... In a strictly legal sense... Yes?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: ...That was the wrong answer, wasn't it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh yeah.
Moments later, the bathroom door swings open, and Justin is hurled out into the hallway!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `Ooof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ooof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And don't ever let me catch you looking at me again!
Jessica slams the door shut. $Scott and Angie help Justin up to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Guessing that didn't go so well...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well... I used the phrase 'good times in the bathroom'...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Why am I so bad with girls?!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I couldn't begin to answer that question...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Come on... Let's go find a slightly less sketchy problem for Justin to solve...
Soon enough, it's lunchtime. Justin and $Scott step out into the hallway... And Angie comes running up to them!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Guys! I just figured out where all the girls are!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Did you seriously not notice that all the popular girls in your class were missing?!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: In retrospect, it did seem unusually bro-lific in there...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You two can be `so` oblivious...
nodes.text_bbcode: You two can be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] oblivious...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well? Are you going to keep us in suspense? Where `is` Centerscore's popular female population?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well? Are you going to keep us in suspense? Where [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] Centerscore's popular female population?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...In the bathroom.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh no... Not another food poisoning epidemic... I `told` the cafeteria to stop serving Mystery Mystery!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no... Not another food poisoning epidemic... I [color=#e23b3b][i]told[/i][/color] the cafeteria to stop serving Mystery Mystery!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No, they're not sick, they're... Well... Preening.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Preening?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And gossiping and chatting and doing a bunch of other girly things.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But why?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It appears that the sudden injection of a few hundred new guys into the school has completely destabilized the dating ecosystem!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Heh, sounds pretty crazy...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's more than crazy... It's an escalating drama storm! If this keeps up, I guarantee you we'll have hair-pulling, locker-vandalizing, and worse!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Justin, you need to go in there and break things up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait, what? `Me?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, what? [color=#e23b3b][i]Me?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Why don't you do it? You're... You know... A girl!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh, no way. That much girl drama makes me practically break out in hives.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But I'm a boy!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You're also the President!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: She's right, little buddy. You've got the great power. Time for some great responsibility.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But... But...
Before Justin can finish his thought, $Scott shoves him through the doors...
Into the girl's bathroom! It's completely packed with girls!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And then there's this guy Lee but I think he might have a girlfriend and there's Mark who seems kind of lame and there's Tom you know Tom and...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hurry up, Amanda! I need another makeover, `stat!` I need to look my absolute best when I meet them!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hurry up, Amanda! I need another makeover, [color=#3b78e2][i]stat![/i][/color] I need to look my absolute best when I meet them!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I already gave you three makeovers! If I make you over again, you'll look the same as when we started!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Would all you idiots just get out of the way? I'm trying to wash my hands!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ahem...
The room goes deathly silent. All of the girls spin around and stare at Justin.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What. Are you. Doing. `HERE?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What. Are you. Doing. [color=#3b78e2][i]HERE?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, I...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Is this some kind of weird play to get back together?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What? No! Plus, I broke up with you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Then why are you here?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I've got one shot at this... Better make it count!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Come again?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You know... Throw a party together! I'm sure if you put your heads together, you could throw the Best Party `Of All Time!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You know... Throw a party together! I'm sure if you put your heads together, you could throw the Best Party [color=#e23b3b][i]Of All Time![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well... I guess it's an option...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I'd consider it... I suppose...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Great! Well, that's one problem easily resolved...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We can meet up at my house after school to begin planning the layout...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Uh, `your` house? We're throwing the party at `my` house.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] house? We're throwing the party at [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] house.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh really? Does `your` house have a state-of-the-art sound system?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh really? Does [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] house have a state-of-the-art sound system?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Yeah, as a matter of fact, it does. Does `your` house have a world-class waterslide?
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, as a matter of fact, it does. Does [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] house have a world-class waterslide?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, different tactic. Your house sucks!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Your face sucks!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Guys, `guys!` Let's table that particular issue for a little while!
nodes.text_bbcode: Guys, [color=#e23b3b][i]guys![/i][/color] Let's table that particular issue for a little while!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Maybe we could start by deciding on a party theme?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Tropical dance fiesta!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: 1920s karaoke shindig!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This isn't going to work out, is it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Formal swing hootenanny!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Hippopotamus pants metropolis!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Now you're just saying words...
The door swings open, and Ms. Prez walks in, munching on a donut.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Now then! Who's ready for a pop-quiz on the reading?
Behind Justin, Hector grumbles...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great! I spent the whole time arguing about Justin's stupid idea! He's the worst!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: At least we can agree on that!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Say what?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, Hector, you think you throw the best party... And Carson, you think yours would be even better...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So why not settle it with a competition?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hector, you can throw your party on Friday, and Carson, you can throw yours on Saturday! That way, we can settle it with a vote on Monday...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And the whole school benefits by having `two` parties to go to this weekend! Nice!
nodes.text_bbcode: And the whole school benefits by having [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] parties to go to this weekend! Nice!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hmmm... A battle of the parties...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: A party-off, if you will....

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm in!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Me too... And I'm taking you down!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Famous last words, new guy. I'm gonna school you so bad, it'll raise your GPA!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Oh, it's on...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's on like Don Juan eating Szechwan prawns at dawn!
$Scott pats Justin on the back.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Good thinking, Justin! Guys like that sometimes just need to duke it out!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: In a weird way... I think I can relate!
In class, Justin sits down in his seat next to Hector. Carson, Lee, and Mark come in a few moments later.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: These chairs are `so` plain.
nodes.text_bbcode: These chairs are [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] plain.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: And none of the lockers have any gold-plating!
Just then, Justin hears someone behind him...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Pssst! Yo! School prez!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Oh! Do you want something, Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Word on the street is you're helping people deal with Spartan issues...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And I suppose you have some kind of a problem for me to resolve?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah! It's that Carson guy... Something about him just `bugs` me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! It's that Carson guy... Something about him just [color=#e23b3b][i]bugs[/i][/color] me!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's... Not really specific enough...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Can you tell me what exactly is troubling you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I can't put my figure on it... Just something about him...
At the front of the room, history teacher Ms. Prez begins her lecture...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Now, as we begin our unit on World War 2, I'd like you to break up into groups of four and begin reading while I grab something from the break room...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ugh, so boring!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Carson, I'll remind you that those who ignore history are doomed to repeat it...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Well, next time I'm planning on waging a land war in Russia, I'll keep that in mind!
The whole class laughs! Ms. Prez scowls and walks out.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: See? That right there! How was that even a joke?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, see, it's funny because realistically, as a high school student, Carson wouldn't have the capacity to wage...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I get why it's a joke, okay?! I just meant it was dumb!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait a minute... I think I understand... Are you... Threatened by Carson? Like, because he's Spartan Academy's version of you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? No! Don't be crazy! He's `nothing` like me!
nodes.text_bbcode: What? No! Don't be crazy! He's [color=#e23b3b][i]nothing[/i][/color] like me!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: By the way, everyone, party at my place this weekend. And let me promise you, it's gonna be the `Best Party Ever!`
nodes.text_bbcode: By the way, everyone, party at my place this weekend. And let me promise you, it's gonna be the [color=#e23b3b][i]Best Party Ever![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, that does it!
Hector stands up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, attention, guys, please ignore this lame weirdo. `I'll` be throwing a party this weekend, and `it'll` be the Best Party Ever!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, attention, guys, please ignore this lame weirdo. [color=#e23b3b][i]I'll[/i][/color] be throwing a party this weekend, and [color=#e23b3b][i]it'll[/i][/color] be the Best Party Ever!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, really!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Oh, `really?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#e23b3b][i]really?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `YEAH REALLY!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]YEAH REALLY![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Guys, guys! Don't fight!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, what do you propose we do?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Why don't you...

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I gotta say, it took me quite a while to undo all the crap you pulled today... All your pathetic little compromises... But rest assured, it's done.
Chad turns to the Spartan guys.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: You guys don't have to worry about sharing this place anymore. From now on... We `rule` this school!
nodes.text_bbcode: You guys don't have to worry about sharing this place anymore. From now on... We [color=#e23b3b][i]rule[/i][/color] this school!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Says who?!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I'm sorry, I guess I'm being rude. The name's Chad Slater. I'm the new school President!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But... `I'm` the school President!
nodes.text_bbcode: But... [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] the school President!

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I don't know how that could be... I mean, `I` was elected President of Spartan Academy... Well, technically Vice-President, but we all know what happened to Percy...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know how that could be... I mean, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] was elected President of Spartan Academy... Well, technically Vice-President, but we all know what happened to Percy...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh, I hate to break it to you, `Chad,` but we're not at Spartan. We're at Centerscore High. And I'm President.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, I hate to break it to you, [color=#e23b3b][i]Chad,[/i][/color] but we're not at Spartan. We're at Centerscore High. And I'm President.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Yeah? According to who?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The... Democratic process?

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Oh really? And who exactly voted for you? I know `I` didn't. Did any of you guys vote for him?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh really? And who exactly voted for you? I know [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] didn't. Did any of you guys vote for him?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I didn't!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Me neither!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Me `neither!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Me [color=#3b78e2][i]neither![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What? It's true! I voted for 'cheesecake!'

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I gotta say, Justin, this doesn't feel all that democratic to me! If 300 students didn't get to participate in an election... Well, that doesn't really seem fair!

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Wow, Chad, you sound... Different...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: Amazing what two weeks of intensive tutoring will do, right?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I hate to admit it... But Chad kind of has a point. I mean, I'd hate to have `him` as my President if I didn't get to have a vote...
nodes.text_bbcode: I hate to admit it... But Chad kind of has a point. I mean, I'd hate to have [color=#e23b3b][i]him[/i][/color] as my President if I didn't get to have a vote...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: See? Even `dumbhair` agrees with me! That means I `have` to be right!
nodes.text_bbcode: See? Even [color=#e23b3b][i]dumbhair[/i][/color] agrees with me! That means I [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] to be right!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But... What am I supposed to do? We already have an election coming up... I guess you can run against me...

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: I was mostly hoping you'd just resign and spare yourself the humiliation.

nodes.speaker: Chad
nodes.text: See, when it comes to elections, one thing's true... In the end, it all comes down to money.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You think you can buy votes?

nodes.speaker: Chad

Carson shudders.
But when I stressed how good this could be for the community as a whole... A pure competition to determine survival of the fittest... Well, they couldn't say no!
I gotta say, you seem different, Chad. Smarter... Craftier... More eloquent...
Have you been reading books?

Centerscore destroyed Spartan High and the Immortals! They took `everything` from us... And now they want us to play nice and act like we're overjoyed to join their crappy little school?
`Never!`
